channel.title: Quiet Profit Sheets: free calculators for Etsy and small online sellers
channel.description: Free fee, pricing and profit calculators for Etsy, Shopify, print on demand and handmade sellers.

item.title: Holiday Order Cutoff Calculator 2026 for Etsy Sellers: USPS, UPS, FedEx
item.description: Free holiday order cutoff calculator for Etsy and online sellers. Enter your processing time and shipping service to get the last day buyers can order for Christmas 2026, from the official USPS, UPS and FedEx deadlines. No signup.

item.title: DTF Transfer Size Chart and T-Shirt Design Size Calculator
item.description: Free DTF transfer size chart and t-shirt design size calculator. Pick the garment, shirt size and placement (full front, back, left chest, sleeve, hoodie, youth, toddler) to get the print width and height in inches and the pixels your artwork needs at 300 DPI. Free printable PDF chart.

item.title: Candle Pricing Calculator: Cost per Candle and Retail Price
item.description: Free candle pricing calculator for small candle businesses and Etsy candle shops. Cost one candle from wax, fragrance load, wick, vessel, label and labor, then get a suggested retail price, a wholesale check and a batch shopping list.

item.title: Printable Wall Art Size Calculator: Print Sizes and DPI for Etsy
item.description: Free print size and DPI calculator for Etsy printable wall art and print on demand. Enter your image's pixel size and see every frame size it prints sharp at (8x10, 11x14, 16x20, A4 and more), which aspect ratios need a crop, and the pixels each size needs. No signup.
